metric_protocol.all20_P5: Always defined, including questions without relevant cases
metric_protocol.all20_F1_zero_as_0: Explicit diagnostic convention for no-positive queries; not conventional F1 conditional on existing gold
metric_protocol.positive_only_F1_nDCG: Exclude no-positive questions; show eligible count and never compare scores across different cohorts as improvement
metric_protocol.repeat_aggregation: Mean across 3 repeats for each question, then macro mean across questions
metric_protocol.RRF: k=60, E weight .75 and C or A weight .25
